name: Tobisawa Takeshi
source:
Takeshi was sent to the Material Department [spoiler]as a substitution for [url=/c92502]Sayaka[/url] when she was sick.[/spoiler]

A hardworking man with a small physique. He possesses the "I can do it!" aura from the first impression.
